# Supply Chain Call: Rack Thermal & Power Bottlenecks

**Date:** 2026-11-10  
**Participant:** Kenji Sato (Senior Thermal Engineer at Taiwan ODM, high credibility supply-chain contact)  
**Source Type:** Meeting Note

## Observations
- During our call, Kenji noted that GB200 NVL72 racks require direct-to-chip liquid cooling because air cooling hits physical limits above 50kW per rack.
- Vertiv (VRT) is currently one of the two qualified coolant distribution unit (CDU) suppliers for Tier-1 hyperscale deployments.
- Unconfirmed floor rumor: some smaller colocation customers may defer Q1 rack deliveries by 4-6 weeks due to local substation transformer lead times, though Tier-1 hyperscalers have pre-secured power allocations.

## Takeaways
- Confirms the **AI Data Center Power Bottleneck** theme is shifting value capture toward liquid cooling and power infrastructure.
- Minor near-term delivery timing risk for NVDA colocation tier, but does not break core hyperscaler capex demand.
